title: Day 8 of AI/Algo Trading (Paper) - Posting for accountability
author: Enzobevmax
selftext:
**Day 8 in the books!**

Finally.... Back in the green

**Changes before today:**

* **Demoted** 1 setup from **Testing 1** to **Graveyard** (My call after system suggestion): Early Sellers into a Pop (all day)
* **Demoted** 1 setup from **Testing 2** to **Graveyard** (My call after system suggestion): Sellers into Strength (all day)
* Testing 2 added Gap-Down Heavy-Selling Short, no RSI condition(Rule) (all day), as a 5-session observation for review
* Testing 2's two Failed Prior-Day-Low Break, SPY-Range Regime setups can take half off early on every trade, outside the 2-a-day limit - Loss limit condition being tested

**Today:** **Primary** \+$146.08 · End-of-day balance $95,025.65 · Running total since Day 1 (10/23): **-$627.64**  
**Milestones:** M1 (3 green days in a row) 1/3 · M2 (8 of last 10 green) 4/8

**Setup Streak facts:**

Green in a row (sessions traded, all accounts):

* Big Gainer Reclaim Short (RW6): 4 in a row, +2.9R
* Gap-Down Bounce Rejection Short (5% gap): 3 in a row, +17.8R
* Generated morning short (RSI(14) 35 or lower, up 2%+ from open): 3 in a row, +6.2R

Red in a row:

* Coil Under the High (6 bars): 4 in a row, -18.8R
* Failed Opening-Range-Low Break Long (0.1 ATR): 4 in a row, -12.5R
* Big Loser VWAP Reclaim Fade (all day): 4 in a row, -11.9R

Green streaks flag promotion candidates, red streaks flag demotion reviews; a streak alone never moves a setup. All three red leaders are already in the Graveyard (Big Loser VWAP Reclaim Fade moved there on 11/02, inside its streak).

\* I weirdly have two Graveyard setups on 7/8 green days, and one with a 4 green streak. Odd!

**Behind the scenes:**

* Every blocked signal is tracked as a what-if trade, with a blocked-signal audit twice a week.
* Nightly loser review, plus the Move Hunt capture rate (how many of the day's big moves the setups caught).
* Replay audit being completed over 10 sessions.
* Every result split by up, down and quiet days, and every rule change logged.

New rules or limits may be added over the next 3-7 days as these reviews finish, since one session isn't the final word.

**Quick update:**

* Two new testing accounts open soon to explore new setup opportunities and give new and existing setups more reps.

**Quick answers to common questions:**

* Claude (Opus 5.5) - Python
* Alpaca API, paper trading, SIP market data (all US exchanges).
* US stocks + ETFs, intraday only (9:50 AM-3:55 PM ET), long and short, nothing held overnight.
* Setups built by basic indicators: RSI, VWAP, volume / buy-sell pressure, gaps, opening range, prior-day highs/lows, ATR.
* Setup Generator - A bot that invented 10 new setups a night (at least 5 long) and trades them on its own paper account. New concept: setups built randomly from random indicators. Paused after 10/28 so the existing ones get tested first.
* Setup Life Cycle - Idea or generator -> 2-yr backtest (costs in) -> test through replay sessions (20+ of them) -> Testing (paper) -> Primary (paper) -> real money after the milestones. Losers move down to the Graveyard, never deleted.
* Promoted / Demoted - Promoted = a setup moves up a level after earning it. Demoted = it moves down a level and keeps proving itself on paper there.
* Avg R - Average result per trade in units of the risk taken, after costs, fees and slippage (factored in already).
* Break-even win rate - Win rate a setup needs just to not lose money.
* Avg R w/o best day - Same, with its single best session removed - spots records carried by one big day.
* Accounts were meant to start at $100k; they could not be reset during earlier testing without conflicts, so some accounts started in a deficit.

**Things I am still wanting:**

* More live reps for setups. Exposure is what makes the data useful.
* Quality setup ideas, especially LONGs!

**Quick thoughts:**

* Would love more collaboration from anyone with ideas. I can help with your setups and you can have mine!
* **Let me know if you want to see anything else each day!**

As always, thanks so much for the support and input!

Fun stuff!
